validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real and well-documented as Iran's fourth national gas trunkline (IGAT-4 / خط چهارم سراسری گاز). The gem.wiki page itself is thinly sourced — its ONLY outbound citation is a generic Wikipedia 'Iran Gas Trunkline' article that does not carry IGAT-4 specs — but independent, non-GEM sources amply confirm the line: digital-oil-gas-map.com (a commercial GIS/map product) and naftema.com (Iranian energy media) both describe IGAT-4 running from the South Pars Gas Complex at Asaluyeh (Jam, Bushehr) carrying South Pars phases 1-5 gas, terminating at the Saveh Pigging Station (Saveh, Markazi). CLASSIFICATION: correct — a high-pressure gas TRANSMISSION trunk (national IGAT series), not gathering/process/oil; Fuel=Gas correct. DUPLICATE: no GEM duplicate — P0442=IGAT2, P0443=IGAT3, P0445=IGAT6, P0446=IGAT7, P0447=IGAT8, P0440=IGAT10; no other IGAT-4 row. GulfPub PE World Map carries TWO 'IGAT 4' features (Assaluyeh->Shiraz 720 km 56in; Assaluyeh->Esfahan 720 km 56in) — these are the SAME physical line as P0444, just split/shorter endpoints in that dataset (Shiraz/Esfahan are mid-corridor points in Fars/Isfahan before the Saveh terminus); a lead, not a GEM duplicate. ATTRIBUTION: endpoints Asaluyeh (Bushehr) -> Saveh (Markazi) confirmed; FuelSource=South Pars confirmed (phases 1-5). Owner 'Iran Ministry of Petroleum' 100% is GEM's standard convention for state lines; transmission operator is NIGC (National Iranian Gas Company) per naftema/digital-oil-gas-map (GulfPub lists NIOC on its IGAT-4 features — NIGC is the correct trunkline operator). SPEC: Length 1145 km confirmed by 2 independent sources (digital-oil-gas-map + naftema), tier high. Diameter blank in GEM — 56 in confirmed by 2 independent + GulfPub (staged as a fill). Capacity 40.15 bcm/y = ~110 MMcm/d (40.15e9/365), the standard 56-in IGAT trunk design capacity cited generically for these lines; no source gives 40.15 specifically for IGAT-4, so medium/design-basis — flagged, not overwritten. Status operating confirmed (line built through the 2000s/1380s decade, in service).

routes.start_name: South Pars Gas Complex, Asaluyeh (Jam, Bushehr province), Iran
routes.end_name: Saveh Pigging Station, Saveh (Markazi province), Iran
routes.corridor_desc: IGAT-4 runs NW/N from the South Pars Gas Complex at Asaluyeh on the Bushehr coast, up through Fars province (route descriptions name Lamerd, Khonj, Jahrom, Arsanjan area) and into Isfahan province (Tiran area), terminating at the Saveh Pigging Station in Saveh, Markazi province — ~1145 km. Endpoints are firmly sourced; the mid-corridor waypoint cities come from Persian route descriptions (medium confidence) and their lat/lon are the real geographic coordinates of those named towns, not a surveyed pipeline trace. digital-oil-gas-map explicitly notes it is NOT a GIS map (no coordinate data), so no meters-level route exists here — a routes-repo trace would still need a GIS source.
routes.researcher_notes: Current sheet endpoints ('Asia'->'Asia') are placeholders and wrong. Established real endpoints from two independent sources: start = South Pars Gas Complex/Asaluyeh (Jam, Bushehr); end = Saveh Pigging Station (Saveh, Markazi). Endpoint coords are the known locations of Asaluyeh (~27.48N,52.61E) and Saveh (~35.02N,50.36E). Waypoint coords are real coordinates of the named Fars/Isfahan corridor towns (Jahrom, Arsanjan, Tiran) taken from route descriptions — flagged medium because the exact pipeline alignment between towns is not GIS-sourced. No coordinates fabricated.

summary: P0444 IGAT-4 confirmed (caveat): real gas trunk, correctly classified, no GEM duplicate; 1145 km + 56 in verified (2 independent + GulfPub), endpoints Asaluyeh->Saveh confirmed; Diameter fill 56 in staged; Capacity 40.15 bcm/y is design-basis (medium).
